ei.title: A Request to Reopen Ticket Offices
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to express my deep concern about the recent change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been replaced with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution. Sincerely, Sarah Roberts

Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② replacing → replaced: 매표소가 대체되는 대상이므로 현재완료 수동태
det.analysis:
✅ ① writing: 'I am writing to express'에서 현재진행형 — 적절
❌ ② replacing → replaced: 'these have been replaced'에서 매표소(these)는 대체되는 대상이므로 현재완료 수동태 have been replaced여야 함. 능동형 replacing은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ experiencing: 'are now experiencing difficulty'에서 현재진행형 — 적절
✅ ④ relied: 'these individuals heavily relied on'에서 과거시제 — 적절
det.tip: have been + 과거분사 = 현재완료 수동태 (대체되어 왔다)

Therefore, I am urging you to ③<u>consider</u> reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would ④<u>regaining</u> access to the railway services. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ regaining → regain: 조동사 would 뒤에는 동사원형
det.analysis:
✅ ① express: 'to express my deep concern'에서 to부정사 — 적절
✅ ② accessing: 'experiencing difficulty accessing'에서 difficulty 뒤 동명사 — 적절
✅ ③ consider: 'to consider reopening'에서 to부정사의 동사원형 — 적절
❌ ④ regaining → regain: 'many people would regain access'에서 조동사 would 뒤에는 동사원형 regain이 와야 함. regaining은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: would + 동사원형: would regain(되찾을 것이다)

det.korean: 익숙하지 않은 사람들이 이용에 '어려움(difficulty)'을 겪는 맥락. ease(수월함)는 반대
det.analysis:

✅ ③ ease — 원문은 difficulty(어려움). ease(수월함)로 바꾸면 '익숙하지 않은 사람들이 수월하게 이용한다'가 되어 문제를 제기하는 글의 논지와 모순 ←정답
❌ ④ heavily — 원문 일치. 직원 도움에 크게(heavily) 의존했다는 맥락에 적절

✅ ④ negative — 원문은 positive(긍정적인). negative(부정적인)로 바꾸면 '부정적인 해결을 기대한다'가 되어 문제 해결을 바라는 민원의 취지와 모순 ←정답
